title: Trade-Cycle Credit for Kessler Care Retail Plan Replacement Purchases
content:
# Trade-Cycle Credit

A replacement purchase of a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans retail plan earns a trade-cycle credit. The credit reads two things about the replaced plan: its cancellation entries dated fewer than 3 whole months before the pricing date (the day the new plan is signed), and how it was bought. The replaced plan is the Essentials, Plus or Premium plan named on the customer's most recent signed cancellation request for a vehicle sold or traded, by request date.

| Replaced plan's ledger and how it was bought | Trade-cycle credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| A cancellation entry for a vehicle sold or traded in the window, on a replaced plan sold on a Kessler vehicle purchase deal (a Vehicle Purchase Agreements deal) | 50.00 |
| Such an entry, on a replaced plan bought on its own | 25.00 |
| No such entry | None |

## Cases (hypothetical, pricing date 14 April)
| Replaced plan's cancellation entry | How the replaced plan was bought | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Vehicle sold or traded, dated 2 April | On a Kessler purchase deal | 50.00 |
| Vehicle sold or traded, dated 15 January (2 whole months back) | Bought on its own | 25.00 |
| Vehicle sold or traded, dated 14 January (3 whole months back) | On a Kessler purchase deal | none |
| No cancellation entry yet | Either | none |

A cancellation entry for any other reason does not earn the credit.
